verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms a working llms.txt at docs.formant.io (HTTP 200, with a proper '# Formant Documentation' header and summary). The cited docs pages are also served as raw .md URLs, which an agent can ingest directly. Missing for 10: no evidence of an llms-full.txt or agent-specific usage guidance, no machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all candidate paths returned 404), and no independent corroboration of how complete the llms.txt index is.
